correct_completion: I would be a doctor now.
full_sentence: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
acceptable_variants: I would be working in a hospital now.
I would be earning a good salary now.

options.text: I know a lot about the subject now.
options.why_wrong: This states a present fact, but a mixed conditional requires a result clause using 'would' plus the present situation.

options.text: I would be a doctor now.
I had become a doctor yesterday.
options.why_wrong: The past perfect result does not match the word 'now' and the 'would' structure that the mixed conditional requires.

options.text: I will become a doctor tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: A future form cannot complete a conditional whose result describes the present, so 'will' is incorrect here.

explanation: A mixed conditional uses the past perfect in the 'if' clause to describe an unreal past condition and 'would' plus a present time word in the main clause to describe its present result.
